row.notes: Takes one job and runs it (old ring/command-buffer note wrong): pops the first eligible job from own list +0x68 under CS [this+0x18] (priority/affinity mask, optional owner filter p4) or steals via Ne_JobQueue_FindBestJob from sibling workers; calls job fn(ctx,worker,arg), lock-decrements group counter +0x168 and on the last one runs Render_Streaming_ScheduleRequest; returns 1 if a job ran, else 0. Callers Ne_JobSignal_WaitWithTimeout, Ne_JobQueue_RunPendingJobs. Better name: Ne_JobQueue_TryRunOneJob (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V7838 better name Ne_JobQueue_TryAcquireJob: callers are Ne_JobSignal_WaitWithTimeout and particle job waits (RunUpdateJobsWait/RunNewJobs), so a job queue take, not renderer command-buffer slot; CS param_1[3], bit63 mask on param_1[0x13]
